usage: A sour citrus fruit commonly used in drinks and cooking
Often used instead of lemon in Southeast Asian and Cantonese dishes
Frequently squeezed for juice or sliced for flavouring
More sour and aromatic than 檸檬
Common in home cooking, drinks, and restaurant contexts
